Seeker '''Kabath''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] and the second in command to master [[Sav]]. After Sav was defeated and killed, Kabath perished soon after, during the gathering of the [[White Maw]] gang leaders at the [[Loramarr (location)|Loramarr]] area on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
